caseName: Joanne Segovia - San Jose Police Officers' Association Opioid Smuggling

character.name: Joanne Segovia
character.title: Executive Director, San Jose Police Officers' Association
character.background: Trusted union official with 20+ years in law enforcement community
character.motivations: Personal enrichment through drug smuggling while maintaining public position

offense.description: Smuggled over 17,000 opioid pills (Tapentadol) into the U.S. from India over multiple years while serving as head of the police union

keyFactors: Claimed drug addiction as primary motivation rather than profit motive
Federal prosecutors agreed to reduce charges based on addiction narrative
High-profile defense strategy that portrayed personal struggle over criminal intent
Leveraged position as union leader for credibility
howTheyGotAwayWithIt.defense_attorney_role: Not explicitly a former US Attorney, but sophisticated legal defense

consequences: Professional disgrace in law enforcement community
Public trust erosion in police union
fallout.avoided: Prison time despite federal drug smuggling charges

narrative_hooks.headline: Union Boss Smuggled 17,000 Opioid Pills, Faced Zero Jail Time
narrative_hooks.question: How did an opioid smuggling case result in probation instead of prison?
narrative_hooks.investigation_angle: The role of addiction narratives in federal sentencing disparities

verification_status: VERIFIED - Published reporting from Bay Area outlets
